ORDINANCE III of 1984
CIVIL SERVANTS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1984
An Ordinance further to amend the
Civil Servants Act, 1973
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 22nd January, 1984]
No. F. 17(1)/84-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called
the Civil Servants (Amendment) Ordinance, 1984.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the first day of July, 1983.

No. F. 17(1)/84-Pub.-The

3. Amendment of section 8, Act LXXI of 1973.-In the said Act, in
section 8.--
(a) in subsection (1), for the
ward "grade", wherever occurring word "pat" shall be
substituted ;
(b) in subsection (2), for the
words and comma "service, cadre or grade" the words " service or
cadre" shall be substituted ;
(c) In subsection (3), for the
word "grade" the word "cadre" shall be substituted ; and
(d) for subsection (4) the
following shall be substituted, namely :--
"(4)
Seniority in a post, service or cadre to which a civil servant is promoted
shall take effect from the date of regular appointment to that post ;
Provided
that civil servants who are selected for promotion to a higher post in one
batch shall, on their promotion to the higher post, retain their inter se
seniority as in the lower post."
